versions.content: The function NvM_Restore PRAM BlockDefaults shall return with E_NOT_OK if the block management type of the given NVRAM block is Specification of NVRAM Manager AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 114 of 197 Document ID 33 : AUTOSAR_SWS_NVRAMManager - AUTOSAR confidenti al - NVM_BLOCK_DATASET, at least one ROM block is configured and the data index points at a NV block.

The function NvM_RestorePRAMBlockDefaults shall return with E_NOT_OK if the block management type of the given NVRAM block is NVM_BLOCK_ DATASET, at least one ROM block is configured and the data index points at a NV block.
